title: Top-down Dodge
prompt:
Build a top-down dodge game in a 600x600 arena. The player is a circle that starts at the centre and moves at a constant speed of at most 5 units per tick in 8 directions; diagonal movement is normalised and the player stays inside the arena. Hazards (circles) enter from the edges at seeded times, aimed near the player, fly straight and are removed once they leave; the spawn rate grows over time. Touching a hazard ends the game. time counts ticks survived and score = floor(time / 60). Keyboard: arrows/WASD. Touch: a virtual joystick - while the finger is down the player moves in the direction from where it went down to where it is now.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, time, width:600, height:600, player:{x,y,r}, hazards:[{x,y,r,vx,vy}]}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.press(name): hold 'up', 'down', 'left' or 'right'
- Game.input.release(name): release it
- Game.debug.setSpawning(on): turn automatic hazards off or on
- Game.debug.clearHazards(): remove all hazards
- Game.debug.spawnHazard(x, y, vx, vy, r): add a hazard

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): survival score, movement, clamping, normalised diagonals, hits, near misses, spawning, seeded hazards, keyboard and joystick.
